name: Model Stealing
definition: Degree to which the model is resistant to model stealing attacks and the difficulty of replicating its functionality.

values.name: Provably Resistant
values.definition: Model provably resistant to model stealing, with formal guarantees on the difficulty of creating a functional copy.

values.name: Strong Defenses
values.definition: Strong defenses against model stealing, making it significantly more difficult and costly to steal the model.

values.name: Some Mitigation
values.definition: Some measures to mitigate model stealing, but a determined attacker can still succeed.

values.name: High Risk
values.definition: High risk of model stealing, and attackers can easily create a functional copy of the model by querying its API.
